jobPostingInfo.title: Principal Software Engineer, Payments
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer, Payments to join our platform engineering team.

  • Own the payments API: latency, availability and error budgets for 2,000 requests per second.
  • Design services in Java and Go on Kubernetes, with Kafka for events and PostgreSQL for the ledger.
  • Lead incident response and postmortems; build Grafana dashboards and automate release checks (CI/CD).

Requirements: 6+ years building backend services in Java or Go.
